data.description: The Loop Climber is an overhead monkey bar frame with a row of yellow rings hung along the top and a ladder at each end. Children climb up one side, swing hand over hand along the rings and climb down the other. Rings ask for more grip and timing than straight bars, so this piece suits children who have already mastered a basic set of monkey bars. The frame takes up 10'10" x 4'8" and needs a safe play area of 15'10" x 7'8", which fits a narrow strip beside a path or boundary wall. It comes in Play Yellow and Lavender. The galvanised pipe frame carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing for you.

Rings ask for more grip and timing than straight bars, so this piece suits children who have already mastered a basic set of monkey bars. The frame takes up 10'10" x 4'8" and needs a safe play area of 15'10" x 7'8", which fits a narrow strip beside a path or boundary wall. It comes in Play Yellow and Lavender. The galvanised pipe frame carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing for you.

props.pText: The uprights and the ring frame are galvanised pipe, so the climber copes with rain and humidity without rusting through. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Children drop from the rings, so lay rubber flooring or another impact-absorbing surface across the whole 15'10" x 7'8" zone and check the ring fixings during routine maintenance.
